jamie-sales: FYI — new prospect (large financial services) asks if we can run an islanded POC: totally air-gapped, no outbound, and 6-week pilot. They want details on packaging, upgrade cadence, and security checklist. Who can help scope?

tyler-solutions: I can take lead. First Qs: do they require hotfixes during POC (weekly)? or only major delta bundles?

jamie-sales: they said zero-binary egress, and they'd prefer <1 upgrade during pilot but may accept signed hotfixes delivered on USB. Also want clarity on licensing for eval models + quantized bundles.

akash-se: Tech notes — we support an offline bundle flow: signed delta bundles + SBOM. Typical artifacts: `operator.tar.gz`, `models/*-quantized.tar`, `runtime.tar.gz`. Verification uses a detached signature and our `redwood-verify` tool. Example: `sha256sum operator.tar.gz && redwood-verify operator.tar.gz.sig`

mara-secops: Security checklist highlights: root CA for deploy (customer-managed), artifact signing key custody (we can supply signing cert or they can bring their own HSM), attestable SBOM, FIPS-validated crypto if required, and an audit log export plan. Need them to fill the security questionnaire before infra handoff.

nathan-sre: Operational constraints: with zero egress we can't phone-home for health telemetry; we offer a periodic telemetry bundle they can opt into via sneakernet. Also for SLA: dedicated on-call coverage is available as an add-on — otherwise POC support is best-effort during business hours.

tyler-solutions: On upgrade cadence — propose this for the POC: single baseline bundle (week 0), one security hotfix (week 3) via signed delta, final patch/rollback (week 5). That keeps the window small and predictable. If they insist on weekly patches we need to add PS hours and sign-off cadence.

jamie-sales: pricing/contract Q: do we charge for the quantized model artifacts separately? and how to handle model license during POC?

akash-se: Usually model artifacts are covered under the evaluation license for 30 days. If they want persistent on-prem model licensing we switch to an enterprise license line item with per-instance or per-GPU terms. Quantized bundles add a one-time packaging fee for the POC (covers engineering time to produce and sign).

mara-secops: Also: they asked about KMS/HSM integration. We support customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own keys) and can integrate with HSMs for signing. Document required: key-rotation policy, HSM access matrix. If they want Redwood to hold signing keys, that's enterprise-only and needs legal OK.

jamie-sales: Great — can we get a concise ops runbook + checklist to share with the customer this afternoon? They want to hand to their security/compliance team.

tyler-solutions: I'll draft runbook: preflight (inventory, offline creds, jumpbox), install (usb copy, `./install.sh --offline`), verify (signature check, `kubectl get pods -n redwood`), patch flow (how to apply `delta.tar.gz` + verify), rollback steps.

akash-se: I'll attach a code snippet for verification in the runbook: ```bash
# verify bundle
sha256sum -c checksums.txt
redwood-verify --cert /path/to/signing.pem bundle.tar.gz.bundle.sig
# install
./install.sh --offline --operator operator.tar.gz
```

sealbot: deploy-bot: signed bundle v1.0.3 ready for distribution (sha256: b3f2...c9e1).

mara-secops: I'll convert the questionnaire answers into a one-page summary (attestation matrix + required docs). Need their SCCM contact and legal rep.

jamie-sales: I'll ping legal and loop in customer's security lead. One more ask: can we offer a short discount on PS hours if they commit to a paid Dedicated trial after POC?

tyler-solutions: Yes — we can offer 20% off up to 40 PS hours if they sign a roll-to-paid letter within 30 days post-POC. I'll include in proposal. :+1:

jamie-sales: Awesome. Next steps: Tyler + Akash to produce runbook + packaging checklist; Mara to draft security summary; I'll send commercial anchor and schedule kickoff if we get the questionnaire back by EOD tomorrow.

nathan-sre: FYI, tagging a known constraint: offline installs on RHEL 7 may need an extra kernel module bundle; flag that early.

jamie-sales: noted. thanks everyone! :rocket:
